blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The MikroTik RB1100AHx4 is a powerful 1U rackmount router featuring 13 Gigabit Ethernet ports and a quad-core ARM Cortex A15 CPU running at 1.4 GHz per core. Designed for high-throughput environments, it delivers exceptional routing performance of over 7.5 Gbps and is ideal for ISPs, corporate networks, and data centers.

Equipped with 1 GB of DDR4 RAM, 128 MB NAND storage, and RouterOS Level 6 license, the RB1100AHx4 offers advanced networking features such as firewall, VPN, bandwidth management, MPLS, BGP, OSPF, and much more.

With dual redundant power supplies and passive cooling, it ensures reliable operation even in demanding network environments. It also includes a smart card slot, microSD, and M.2 SATA interface for additional storage or user authentication.

Key Features:

  • Model: RB1100AHx4

  • CPU: Annapurna Labs Alpine AL21400 (4-Core, 1.4 GHz ARM Cortex-A15)

  • RAM: 1 GB DDR4

  • Storage: 128 MB NAND, microSD, and M.2 SATA slot

  • Ethernet Ports: 13 x Gigabit Ethernet

  • Performance: Up to 7.5 Gbps throughput

  • Form Factor: 1U rackmount

  • Power: Dual redundant AC power supplies

  • Operating System: MikroTik RouterOS, Level 6 License

  • Cooling: Passive heatsink with high airflow design

  • Additional: Smart card slot, M.2 SATA for storage expansion

Ideal For:

  • Internet Service Providers (ISP)

  • Enterprise and Data Center Core Routing

  • Border Gateway or VPN Concentrator

  • Carrier-Grade NAT / Load Balancer

  • Firewall and Routing Aggregation
